summary.en: Salvadoran forces, numbering about 2,000, are conducting a search for four soldiers missing after a gang ambush near Port-au-Prince while denying any airstrikes. Haitian gang leaders have written to the United Nations asking for mediation and dialogue with security forces, with one leader saying he has "raised the white flag" and warning President Bukele about rising violence. The United Nations confirmed 193 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP. These actions mark a shift from earlier reporting, adding a direct Salvadoran military presence and formal UN mediation requests by gang leaders.
summary.nb: Salvadoranske styrker, på rundt 2 000 personer, leter etter fire soldater som er savnet etter et gjengoverfall nær Port-au-Prince, samtidig som de benekter luftangrep. Haitiske gjengledere har skrevet til FN og bedt om mekling og dialog med sikkerhetsstyrkene, og en leder har sagt at han har "løftet det hvite flagget" og advart president Bukele om økende vold. FN bekreftet 193 dødsfall i kamper i 2024, ifølge UCDP. Disse handlingene markerer et skifte fra tidligere rapportering, med en direkte salvadoransk militær tilstedeværelse og formelle FN-meklingsforespørsler fra gjenglederne.

background.title: Haitian conflict
background.extract: Since 2020, Haiti's capital Port-au-Prince has been the site of an ongoing armed conflict between rival gangs and the state. The government of Haiti and national security forces have struggled to maintain their control of Port-au-Prince amid this conflict, with gangs speculated to control up to 90% of the city by 2023. In response to the escalating fighting, an armed vigilante movement, known as bwa kale, also emerged, with the purpose of fighting the gangs. On 2 October 2023, United Nations Security Council Resolution 2699 was approved, authorizing a Kenya-led "multinational security support mission" to Haiti. Until 2024, the war was between two major groups and their allies: the Revolutionary Forces of the G9 Family and Allies and the G-Pèp. However, in February 2024 the two rival groups united in a coalition known as Viv Ansanm, formed to oppose the government and the UN mission.
